text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D for gains felt satisfying, but a small gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider the whole portfolio.","I sold Stock E for a tiny gain, which reminded me not to focus only on whether each position is above its average cost.","My account value moved up and down across periods, and past price changes do not predict future returns, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves."]}
